AGENDA
  SENIOR SERVICES COMMITTEE MEETING
  ADULT RECREATION CENTER
  201 E. Colorado St.
  Glendale, CA 91205
Welcome to the meeting of the Senior Services Committee. Meetings are open to the public and
held at the Adult Recreation Center at 201 E. Colorado Street, Glendale, CA 91205. Meeting minutes
will be available for viewing on the City Website at https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/public-
meeting-portal. If you have any questions about matters on the agenda or requests for assistance,
please contact (818) 548-3715 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES DURING THE MEETING.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related
to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and
are public records, will be available for review in the Community Services & Parks Administration
Office, 633 E. Broadway, Room 305, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who wish
to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the Community
Services & Parks Administration Office at (818) 548-2782, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled
meeting. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.
  JULY 13, 2022 AT 3:00 PM

 1. ROLL CALL
  a. Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the July 13,
  2022, quarterly meeting of the Senior Services Committee Meeting was posted on or
  before Friday, July 8, 2022, on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.
 2. INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. Introduction of new committee member, Dr. Adira E. Navarro, Program Manager-
  USC Verdugo Hills Hospital-Community Resources Center of Aging (CRCA).
 3. CONSENT ITEMS
  a. Approval of the Minutes of the March 25, 2021, Senior Services Committee
  Quarterly Meeting
 4. COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS
 5. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed five (5)
  minutes. The Committee may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision. The
  Director or designee may refer the matter to the proper section for investigation and report.
6. ACTION ITEMS
  a. Selection of New Chair and Vice Chair of the Senior Services Committee
  b. Senior Needs Assessment and Outreach Plan
  1. Motion to review and provide feedback on the 2022 Senior Needs Assessment process
7. REPORTS - INFORMATION ONLY
  a. Senior Programs and Events Update 2022
  b. Senior Services Update 2022
8. ADJOURNMENT
